newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Death toll in Belgian airshow crash rises to nine.
newsitem.headline: Death toll in Belgian airshow crash rises to nine.

text.p: The death toll from a plane crash at an airshow in the Belgian town of Ostend rose to nine after a 19-year-old Red Cross worker died in hospital on Sunday afternoon, Belga news agency reported.
The other eight victims, including the pilot, died immediately when the light plane mounting an aerobatics display crashed onto a Red Cross tent on Saturday at around five p.m (1500 GMT).
